name: automationml
label: AutomationML (Manufacturing)
description: Factory planning and engineering data exchange for manufacturing digital twins
short_description: Factory planning and engineering data exchange for manufacturing digital twins
long_description: AutomationML (IEC 62714) is the standard for engineering data exchange in discrete manufacturing, using CAEX (Computer Aided Engineering Exchange) as its XML foundation. The schema captures engineering projects, instance hierarchies (machine layouts), internal elements (individual components), and connections (signal flows and physical links).
when_to_use: Use for factory planning systems, engineering CAD data management, production line commissioning tools, or manufacturing digital twin platforms. Supported by Siemens TIA Portal, EPLAN, and ABB Ability. Required for data exchange between planning (PLC programming), simulation (MATLAB/Simulink), and execution (SCADA/MES) tools in IEC 62264-aligned architectures.

table_notes.aml_project: Top-level AML document container; each row is one .aml file import with authorship and version metadata.
table_notes.aml_instance_hierarchy: Named grouping of physical/logical elements within a project; maps to the CAEX InstanceHierarchy element in IEC 62714.
table_notes.aml_internal_element: Individual engineering component (device, cable, signal, software module) nested inside a hierarchy; supports self-referential parent/child trees for assemblies.
table_notes.aml_connection: Directed or undirected link between two InternalElement interface ports; represents signal cables, communication links, or kinematic constraints.

aml_project.name: id
aml_project.description: Surrogate primary key for this AML project import

aml_project.name: name
aml_project.description: Human-readable project name, typically from the CAEX/@Name attribute

aml_project.name: version
aml_project.description: AML file version string (e.g. '2.10'), from CAEX/@Version

aml_project.name: author
aml_project.description: Engineering author or originating tool that produced this AML file

aml_project.name: created_at
aml_project.description: Timestamp when this project record was first imported into the database

aml_project.name: modified_at
aml_project.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this project record

aml_instance_hierarchy.name: id
aml_instance_hierarchy.description: Surrogate primary key for this instance hierarchy

aml_instance_hierarchy.name: project_id
aml_instance_hierarchy.description: Reference to the owning aml_project; cascade-delete if project is removed

aml_instance_hierarchy.name: description
aml_instance_hierarchy.description: Free-text description of the hierarchy's engineering scope or purpose

aml_internal_element.name: id
aml_internal_element.description: Surrogate primary key for this engineering component element

aml_internal_element.name: parent_id
aml_internal_element.description: Self-referential FK to parent element; NULL for top-level elements in the hierarchy

aml_internal_element.name: name
aml_internal_element.description: Component name as it appears in the engineering tool (e.g. 'PLC_Rack_01')

aml_internal_element.name: description
aml_internal_element.description: Free-text engineering description or notes for this component

aml_internal_element.name: role_classes
aml_internal_element.description: Array of applied RoleClass references; each entry: {name, class_path, supported_role_class}

aml_internal_element.name: interface_classes
aml_internal_element.description: Array of defined interfaces (ports); each entry: {name, class_path, id, direction}

aml_internal_element.name: attributes
aml_internal_element.description: Key-value engineering attributes from CAEX Attribute elements; e.g. {IP: '192.168.1.10', Rack: 0}

aml_internal_element.name: geometry
aml_internal_element.description: Optional 3D placement data for digital-twin visualization; e.g. {x, y, z, rx, ry, rz}

aml_connection.name: id
aml_connection.description: Surrogate primary key for this connection record

aml_connection.name: hierarchy_id
aml_connection.description: Reference to the aml_instance_hierarchy that owns this connection

aml_connection.name: name
aml_connection.description: Optional engineering label for the connection (e.g. 'X1_to_Motor_PE')

aml_connection.name: partner_side_a
aml_connection.description: Source element of the connection; references aml_internal_element

aml_connection.name: partner_side_b
aml_connection.description: Target element of the connection; references aml_internal_element
